clues: Folk say this town stands on seven hills, just like the town of Rome. The tale links this town to that great town of the past.
The summers here are hot and damp, with warm wet air for months. The winters here are cold, with snow that falls and stays for weeks.
In 1862, the lands of Wallachia and Moldavia joined as one new land. This town then took the top job as chief town of the whole land.
The law house in this town is the most big one of its kind in the world. Both groups of law men meet in its halls, and a great art hall sits there too.
Romania is run from this town, where the work of state is done each day. More folk live here than in any other town in the land.
